# PCB candidate test footprints

These compact KiCad 8 fixtures preserve pad size, numbering, pitch, type, and layers from the official KiCad 8.0.0 footprint library. Decorative text and graphics were reduced for focused parser tests. The fixtures are adapted from:

- `Resistor_SMD.pretty/R_0805_2012Metric.kicad_mod`: https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints/-/raw/8.0.0/Resistor_SMD.pretty/R_0805_2012Metric.kicad_mod
- `Connector_PinHeader_2.54mm.pretty/PinHeader_1x04_P2.54mm_Vertical.kicad_mod`: https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints/-/raw/8.0.0/Connector_PinHeader_2.54mm.pretty/PinHeader_1x04_P2.54mm_Vertical.kicad_mod

KiCad footprint library copyright belongs to its contributors. These adapted fixtures are offered under the [KiCad library CC BY-SA 4.0 license](https://www.kicad.org/libraries/license/). They test software behavior; they are not a substitute for verifying an actual component datasheet or running KiCad DRC.
